summary: The PR addresses the issue of tearDown being executed on skipped tests when running with --pdb. The changes are minimal and focused on the problem.

issues.description: The function _is_skipped is added, which could potentially be reused elsewhere in the codebase for checking skip status, improving maintainability.
The naming convention for the new function _is_skipped is consistent with the rest of the codebase, but it could be more descriptive, such as is_test_case_skipped.
